chapter: Critics and the thinning Chicago scene (retyped)
title: Helen Oakley, the first critic he met
summary: Hodes says the first critic he met was Helen Oakley, who came to hear Jess Stacy at the Subway. It was the first time he learned that non-musicians listened to them.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: So -- but, anyway, very few people -- the first critic I met was Helen Oakley. She came to the Subway. Jess Stacy was playing there.

World's longest bar. And she came in there and that's the first time I'd heard that there was people who were not musicians that were listening to us. I never thought anybody listened to musicians but other musicians. I suddenly discovered there were a few people here and there.
